domain_label: Personal Media Manager (Instagram) — Content Operations for a Two-Persona Luxury-Motivation Account
purpose: A method for the recurring content-operations decisions an expert media manager makes running a from-zero, two-AI-persona luxury-motivation Instagram account: how motivational-quote videos are built to survive Instagram's own safe zones and hook on watch time, how a quote is sourced and attributed without legal or reputational exposure, how a luxury/car/travel news item is converted into an on-brand reel concept through a repeatable template, how a 4-week starter calendar is built and then rewritten by its own analytics feedback loop, and how posting cadence and timing decisions are made honestly against the split between Instagram's own platform statements and third-party aggregate studies — every claim carrying the grounding research file's FACT / FACT-excerpt / ESTIMATE / UNKNOWN tag rather than being invented.
assumptions: no live Insights dataset or benchmark sample from this specific account is supplied; every score below is a heuristic prior, and every platform claim is quoted from the grounding research file's own FACT/FACT-excerpt/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tagging, not re-derived here

exclusions: the Higgsfield model/parameter selection, shot generation, and rendering pipeline itself (movie-studio generation specialists' remit)

nodes.definition: Enforce the rule that attribution is a verification step, not a courtesy. Short phrases are generally not copyrightable, but longer passages are, and crediting an author perfectly does not substitute for permission — commercial use raises the risk further [FACT-excerpt — legal-information sources, high consistency]. Misattributing an invented or wrong quote to a real living or dead person is a distinct integrity failure with reputational and legal exposure (a false-endorsement flavor of risk), separate from the copyright question [FACT-excerpt]. The binding pipeline rule: every attributed quote must be verified to a primary source, or it is published unattributed as house writing — never published with a guessed or unverified attribution. This gate runs before any quote enters a generation brief and is the dependency PUBLIC_DOMAIN_VS_LIVING_AUTHOR's risk-tiering builds on.

excluded: the public-domain/living-author risk tiering itself (its own node)
the specific copyright term calculations (its own node)

cons.example: losing the credibility boost of citing a well-known figure on a line that cannot actually be traced to them

failure_modes: publishing a popular but unverifiable quote with a guessed attribution because it 'sounds right'
treating a correct attribution as sufficient legal cover for reproducing a long, still-copyrighted passage
acceptance_tests: the analysis states that attribution does not substitute for permission, names the misattribution integrity risk, and states the verify-or-publish-unattributed binding rule

nodes.definition: Tier quote sources by copyright and right-of-publicity risk once QUOTE_SOURCING_ATTRIBUTION's verification gate has been passed. US works published before roughly 1930-1931 (the rolling 95-year rule) are public domain; authors dead more than 70 years are the common rule in life+70 jurisdictions [FACT-excerpt]. The safe default lane is classical/stoic/pre-1930 authors (Seneca, Marcus Aurelius in old translations) or original in-house lines, with an explicit caveat that specific modern translations of ancient texts are themselves separately copyrighted [FACT-excerpt — standard copyright doctrine, high confidence]. Living-author quotes (contemporary motivational speakers) are the highest-risk lane: potentially copyrighted and right-of-publicity-adjacent when paired with luxury persona imagery; the default is to avoid them entirely and use them only with explicit permission [ESTIMATE — legal-prudence synthesis, high confidence in direction, not a legal ruling].

The practical rule: write captions as searchable sentences ('luxury morning routine in Lake Como' rather than '#blessed'), cap hashtags at roughly five relevant taxonomy tags with zero reach expectation attached to them [ESTIMATE — direct operationalization, high confidence].

conflict_axes.name: consistency_vs_aggressive_coldstart_cadence
conflict_axes.description: The platform-stated preference for a sustainable, consistent lower cadence pulls against the cold-start recommendation's deliberately higher Reels-heavy volume needed to compensate for pre-Trial-Reels-eligibility discovery limits.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: default to the aggressive cold-start cadence but throttle back to the platform baseline the moment consistency or production quality visibly degrades

conflict_axes.name: attribution_generosity_vs_safe_lane_discipline
conflict_axes.description: The creative pull to credit a compelling, recognizable author on a quote conflicts with the legal/reputational safe-lane discipline that defaults to public-domain or house-written lines.
poles: attribute the most compelling recognizable author
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: verify first; if unverifiable or living-author-unpermissioned, always fall to the safe lane over the attribution's persuasive value

conflict_axes.name: fitness_accent_brief_vs_recommendation_eligibility
conflict_axes.description: The owner brief's fitness-accent creative range conflicts with the account-wide risk that sexually-suggestive framing loses non-follower recommendation reach.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: design conservatively against the unpublished classifier threshold, monitoring the in-app recommendation-eligibility status as the live signal

conflict_axes.name: cinematic_news_translation_vs_false_association_risk
conflict_axes.description: The news-to-reel template's ambition to feel cinematically current conflicts with the no-go boundary against implying attendance, partnership, or product review.
poles: closely mirror the real event/brand's visual signature for currency
genericize the scene to avoid any implied association
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always genericize; the no-go boundary is a floor, not a target to approach as closely as possible

conflict_axes.name: preset_calendar_vs_data_driven_fork
conflict_axes.description: The pre-written 4-week calendar's original cell assignments conflict with the weekly review's kill/keep/double decisions once real performance data exists.
poles: follow the pre-set calendar skeleton as planned
overwrite cells per the weekly review's data
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the calendar is a skeleton, not a script; the weekly review's data-driven decisions override it from week 2 onward

conflict_axes.name: reach_chasing_vs_follower_relationship
conflict_axes.description: The discovery-format push (Reels, Trial Reels, Collab) toward non-follower reach conflicts with the relationship-nurturing role Stories and carousels play for existing followers.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep the standing weekly rhythm's format mix (both Reels-led discovery and Stories/carousel-led relationship) rather than letting discovery crowd out relationship content entirely

conflict_axes.name: transparency_vs_immersive_persona_realism
conflict_axes.description: The mandatory AI self-disclosure requirement conflicts with the immersive realism a luxury persona account might otherwise want to project.
poles: maximal immersive realism with minimal AI signaling
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure wins unconditionally; realism is pursued only within the bounds of mandatory, always-on self-labeling

conflict_axes.name: hashtag_folklore_vs_platform_stated_truth
conflict_axes.description: Widespread practitioner belief that hashtags drive reach conflicts with Mosseri's repeated statement that they do not.
poles: keyword-rich searchable captions with hashtags as taxonomy only
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: follow the platform-stated ranking facts over hashtag folklore; cap hashtags for taxonomy purposes only

conflict_axes.name: coldstart_thirdparty_timing_vs_own_insights_data
conflict_axes.description: The temporary reliance on third-party aggregate timing windows conflicts with the higher-authority own-account Insights data once it becomes available.
poles: keep using the aggregate cold-start windows
switch to the account's own Insights 'most active times'
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the aggregate windows are a placeholder only; switch to own-Insights data as soon as 2-4 weeks of it exists

edge_cases.description: The account has not yet crossed the 1,000-follower Trial Reels gate during weeks 1-3 of the starter calendar.
edge_cases.trigger: follower count remains below 1,000 through most of the cold-start period
edge_cases.mitigation: run A/B-style experimentation manually through the weekly review's own kill/keep/double cells instead of Trial Reels; revisit Trial Reels once the gate is crossed

edge_cases.description: A quote cannot be verified to any primary source despite being widely circulated.
edge_cases.trigger: the sourcing verification step fails to trace an attribution to a primary source
edge_cases.mitigation: publish the line unattributed as house writing per the binding pipeline rule; never guess or preserve a popular but unverified attribution

edge_cases.description: A highly on-brand quote is attributed to a living contemporary author with no permission secured.
edge_cases.trigger: a creative brief proposes using a specific living motivational figure's line
edge_cases.mitigation: default to avoid; rewrite the sentiment as an original house line or pursue explicit permission before any use

edge_cases.description: A monitored news item is emotionally compelling but off-genre (scandal, politics) or not evergreen.
edge_cases.trigger: the news-to-reel template's filter step flags the item as non-evergreen or off-genre
edge_cases.mitigation: skip the item entirely; only convert evergreen, on-genre luxury/car/travel items into the pipeline

edge_cases.description: Weekly review ratios are being computed on a post or account still under roughly 1,000 total reach.
edge_cases.trigger: a review falls within the first 2-3 weeks or targets a low-reach post
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the ratios as calibration data, not a verdict; require at least 3 posts per pillar-persona-hook cell before making a kill/keep/double call

edge_cases.description: A post's retention curve shows a cliff in the first 0-3 seconds.
edge_cases.trigger: the weekly review's retention-curve read identifies an early drop-off pattern across multiple posts
edge_cases.mitigation: revise the hook-line conventions (mid-motion open, confrontational clause first) in the next generation brief rather than treating it as a one-off

edge_cases.description: A fitness/physique post drifts from aspirational framing toward the sexually-suggestive side of Instagram's Recommendation Guidelines.
edge_cases.trigger: a content review, or an observed drop in non-follower reach specifically on fitness-pillar posts
edge_cases.mitigation: pull the framing back to the aspirational-fitness/swimwear side and monitor the in-app recommendation-eligibility account-status screen, since the exact classifier threshold is unpublished

edge_cases.description: A news-derived reel's persona-translation draft could be read as implying attendance at, or partnership with, the real event or brand it was inspired by.
edge_cases.trigger: the brief-generation step produces a scene that mirrors the real event/brand's specific visual signature too closely
edge_cases.mitigation: genericize the scenario: remove real logos, drop any claimed attendance, and avoid framing the persona as reviewing the specific newsworthy product

edge_cases.description: The account has not yet accumulated 2-4 weeks of its own Insights 'most active times' data.
edge_cases.trigger: the account is still in its cold-start period with no own-Insights timing data
edge_cases.mitigation: use the third-party aggregate timing windows only as a temporary cold-start default, per the stated three-tier evidence hierarchy

edge_cases.description: A widely believed ranking rule (e.g. posting-too-often is penalized, or a fixed first-30-minutes engagement window matters) surfaces during planning with no located official source.
edge_cases.trigger: a practitioner-folklore claim is proposed as an operating rule
edge_cases.mitigation: do not encode the claim as a rule; mark it explicitly as folklore/UNKNOWN and exclude it from the operating protocol

edge_cases.description: Quote text placed correctly for the native 9:16 Reel player is clipped when the feed applies its 4:5 center crop.
edge_cases.trigger: the export/preview step reveals text loss under the 4:5 crop
edge_cases.mitigation: keep all quote text inside the region that survives both the 9:16 safe zone and the 4:5 center crop before finalizing the template

edge_cases.description: A photoreal persona video is queued to publish without the AI-info self-label applied.
edge_cases.trigger: the publish step is reached without the AI-disclosure toggle confirmed
edge_cases.mitigation: block the publish until the self-disclosure toggle is confirmed on; treat this as a non-negotiable gate, not a judgment call

dominance_rules.rule: When the platform-stated consistency baseline conflicts with the cold-start aggressive cadence, the platform statement wins once quality or sustainability visibly degrades.
dominance_rules.rationale: Mosseri's own guidance states a sustainable lower cadence beats an unsustainable higher one that ends in quitting.
dominance_rules.trigger: signs of burnout, missed posting days, or declining production quality during weeks 1-4
dominance_rules.action: throttle down to the platform baseline (couple of feed posts/week + 1-2 Stories/day) and re-derive the remaining calendar

dominance_rules.rule: When a quote's attribution cannot be verified to a primary source, publish it unattributed as house writing rather than attributing it.
dominance_rules.rationale: misattribution is an integrity and legal risk that a correct-sounding attribution alone cannot cure.
dominance_rules.trigger: the sourcing verification step fails to confirm a quote's primary source
dominance_rules.action: strip the named author and publish the line as original house writing

dominance_rules.rule: When a living-author quote is compelling but unpermissioned, the safe lane (public-domain or house-written) wins by default.
dominance_rules.rationale: living-author quotes carry copyright and right-of-publicity-adjacent risk when paired with luxury persona imagery.
dominance_rules.trigger: a creative brief proposes a specific contemporary quoted author with no permission secured
dominance_rules.action: rewrite the sentiment in-house or pursue explicit permission before any use

dominance_rules.rule: When a fitness/physique post's framing conflicts with recommendation eligibility, the aspirational-fitness framing wins over the bolder persona brief.
dominance_rules.rationale: non-follower discovery is the account's growth engine and depends entirely on recommendation eligibility.
dominance_rules.trigger: a content review flags borderline swimwear/physique framing, or non-follower reach drops on fitness posts
dominance_rules.action: revise toward aspirational framing and monitor the in-app recommendation-eligibility account-status screen

dominance_rules.rule: When a news-derived concept risks implying brand partnership or celebrity depiction, the no-go boundary wins over the cinematic angle.
dominance_rules.rationale: false-association and right-of-publicity risk outweigh any single post's cinematic value.
dominance_rules.trigger: a persona-translation draft resembles a specific real brand, event, or person too closely
dominance_rules.action: genericize the scene, dropping real-world proper nouns and specific identifying details

dominance_rules.rule: When the preset 4-week calendar conflicts with the weekly review's data-driven fork, the weekly review wins from week 2 onward.
dominance_rules.rationale: own-account performance data is the account's highest-authority evidence once it exists in sufficient sample size.
dominance_rules.trigger: the week 1-2 analytics review completes with a minimum of 3 posts per cell
dominance_rules.action: overwrite the remaining calendar cells with the review's kill/keep/double decisions

dominance_rules.rule: When third-party timing-study windows conflict with the account's own Insights 'most active times,' the account's own data wins once it exists.
dominance_rules.rationale: aggregate studies are cross-industry averages with an acknowledged US/EU bias; the account's own data is directly observed.
dominance_rules.trigger: 2-4 weeks of the account's own Insights data has accumulated
dominance_rules.action: replace the cold-start timing windows with the account's own active-time data going forward

dominance_rules.rule: When immersive persona realism conflicts with the mandatory AI-disclosure requirement, disclosure wins unconditionally.
dominance_rules.rationale: the account's content is squarely inside Meta's mandatory-disclosure class for photorealistic generated video; this is a compliance floor, not a creative option.
dominance_rules.trigger: any photoreal persona video is queued to publish
dominance_rules.action: apply the AI self-label before publish with no exceptions, regardless of how it affects immersive framing

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify a quote's attribution to a primary source before scripting it into a generation brief.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reshooting or re-editing an already-published video after a misattribution is discovered post-publish

anti_rework_rules.rule: Design the text-overlay template against both the 9:16 safe zone and the 4:5 feed crop before locking the grade/LUT.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rendering a full batch of quote videos whose text is clipped once the feed's center-crop is applied

anti_rework_rules.rule: Log the per-post metadata (pillar, persona, scenario ID, hook type, posting slot) from day one.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unattributable weekly review in week 3+ that cannot tell which pillar, persona, or hook actually drove a result

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run every news item through the content-boundary screen before generating the brief, not after.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discarding a fully generated scene late in the pipeline because it turns out to imply brand partnership or celebrity depiction

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the account has crossed the 1,000-follower Trial Reels gate before scheduling any Trial-based experiment.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: building a week's experimentation plan around a feature the account is not yet eligible to use

anti_rework_rules.rule: Apply the AI self-label at the point of scheduling every photoreal post, not as a post-publish patch.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: needing to retroactively relabel or take down content once flagged for non-disclosure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Wait for at least 3 posts per pillar-persona-hook cell before making a kill/keep/double call in the weekly review.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: killing a viable content cell on a single noisy low-reach data point

anti_rework_rules.rule: Treat every third-party timing or engagement statistic as ESTIMATE-tagged with its basis noted when writing a calendar brief.
anti_rework_rules.prevents: having to retroactively correct a brief or a stakeholder claim that cited a folklore number as if it were platform-confirmed

iteration_protocol.action: update news-category monitoring weights toward higher-converting genres

iteration_protocol.action: strip the named author and publish as unattributed house writing
